required_scopes: Read-only access to public Trakt lists

intro.title: Connect Trakt
intro.summary: Lets you turn a public Trakt list into a collection. Only the list's address and your Trakt client id go to Trakt.

steps.title: Account
steps.description: Sign in to Trakt or create a free account, then create an app of your own.
instructions: Open your Trakt apps page and choose New Application.
Give it any name. For the redirect address use urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob.

steps.title: Get credential
steps.description: Copy the Client ID shown for your Trakt app. The client secret is not needed.

steps.title: Connect
steps.description: Library will perform a read-only connection check.

troubleshooting.title: Trakt did not accept this client id
troubleshooting.message: Copy the Client ID again from your Trakt app.
instructions: Make sure you copied the Client ID, not the Client Secret.

troubleshooting.title: Trakt rate limit reached
troubleshooting.message: Trakt limits how often an app can ask. Wait before trying again.

troubleshooting.title: Trakt is temporarily unavailable
troubleshooting.message: Your client id may be valid. Try again later.

troubleshooting.title: Library could not reach Trakt
troubleshooting.message: Check this server's internet, DNS, proxy, and firewall settings.

skip_consequences.summary: Trakt list addresses cannot be turned into collections. Other list sources and list files, including a Trakt export file, still work.

credentials.label: Trakt Client ID
credentials.format_hint: The Client ID shown for your Trakt app.

declaration.changelog: First built-in version: public Trakt lists and watchlists as collections. Your own private lists need signing in to Trakt, which is not available yet.
